name: Melee
blurb: High-defense close-range fighter using swords, spears, and true-melee weapons, backed by Calamity's rage and adrenaline durability.

subclasses.name: True Melee
subclasses.description: Short-range swords, spears, and contact-focused melee weapons.

subclasses.name: Melee
subclasses.description: General melee weapons - swords and spears that fire or hurl a projectile, which Calamity groups simply as melee rather than true melee.

subclasses.name: Yoyo
subclasses.description: Cursor-controlled yoyos that trade reach and safety for sustained control.

subclasses.name: Boomerang
subclasses.description: Thrown melee weapons that arc out and return.

subclasses.name: Flail
subclasses.description: Chain-based melee options with awkward but powerful area control.

subclasses.name: Projectile Melee
subclasses.description: Melee weapons that fire or hurl a projectile - swords with beams, plus thrown knives and spears.

name: Ranger
blurb: Ammo-based damage dealer relying on guns, bows, and launchers for strong sustained ranged DPS at the cost of managing ammunition.

subclasses.name: Other
subclasses.description: Miscellaneous ranged weapons that fit no standard type.

name: Mage
blurb: Mana-fueled spellcaster with high-damage, versatile magic weapons balanced against a limited mana pool and lower defense.

subclasses.name: Magic Guns
subclasses.description: Magic weapons that fire like guns.

subclasses.name: Other
subclasses.description: Miscellaneous magic weapons that fit no standard type.

name: Summoner
blurb: Minion- and whip-focused class that commands summoned allies to fight while the player dodges, offering strong passive DPS but fragile defense.

subclasses.name: Other
subclasses.description: Miscellaneous summon weapons that fit no standard type.

name: Rogue
blurb: Calamity's signature stealth-based throwing class that builds stealth while still to unleash powerful empowered strikes from thrown weapons.

subclasses.name: Other
subclasses.description: Miscellaneous rogue weapons that fit no standard type.
